data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series C-stage AI & Software company founded by Chase Lochmiller and Cully Cavness, currently valued at $10.0B+ post-money with $3.0B+ total raised. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir), with near-stage peers including Figure AI ($39.0B), Skild AI ($14.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier from Series C to next-stage funding, implying a valuation of $17.0B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $14.0B, with the peer range spanning $8.3B to $39.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business models and capital intensity within frontier AI.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $11.9B (low) to $19.6B (high), with a median of $15.5B. This implies modest upside from the current $10.0B valuation under stage-progression assumptions, while peer-median positioning suggests Crusoe trades near the lower-middle of its comp set. Key uncertainties include capital requirements relative to revenue trajectory, near-term funding availability, and the sustainability of current AI sector valuations as we move toward Series D and beyond.
